verdict.rationale: GST is a government tax registration, filing and payment portal with a developer API portal. It is not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
